messages:
maria-peopleops: Quick heads-up: Execs approved a small structural change in Eng Runtime + a focused hiring wave. Summary: split runtime into Core + Ops, 7 new reqs approved. Details below.

alex-vp-eng: Thanks everyone 8522; this should accelerate a few blocker projects around tail latency and deploy reliability.

maria-peopleops: Hiring breakdown: 3 Senior Inference Engineers (Core), 2 Senior Backend Engineers (Runtime Ops), 1 Staff SRE, 1 Product Ops. Recruiting will open reqs today.

tanya-ramos: I'll transition to Manager, Runtime Ops. My priorities: autoscaling policies, rollout pipelines, and incident playbooks. Will hire two senior engs and coordinate on SLOs with product.

sunil-patel: I'll lead Runtime Core as Director focusing on kernel optimizations and model execution performance. Planning cross-team profiling days once hires start.

jen-recruiter: I'll post JD links in #recruiting in ~1hr. Interview focus: Core = low-level perf + profiling; Ops = deploy infra and incident response. ETA: first onsites in 6-10 weeks.

lina-chavez: Can People Ops draft a standard intro template for new hires? Also proposing a "project lightning" brownbag for each new joiner during week 2.

maria-peopleops: Yes to both. We'll run salary calibration Thurs and publish bands. Brownbag scheduled for second Friday post-start.

hr-bot: Reminder: add hiring panel members in Greenhouse by EOD Thursday.

jen-recruiter: Action items for managers: add panel + shortlist criteria. I'll coordinate debrief rubric.

maria-peopleops: Thanks all. If anyone expects impact on headcount beyond these 7 roles, DM me before Friday so we can freeze the plan.
